name: elluminate
description:
The elluminate MCP server allows to connect to the elluminate platform, upload data, create new models, collections and criteria and run experiments.

Agents can autonomously evaluate any AI model, agent or system through the MCP Server.

_published_faq.name: How do I add elluminate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add elluminate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.elluminate.de/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the elluminate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: elluminate lists 45 MCP tools, including add_criteria_to_criterion_set, add_criterion_set_to_prompt_template, add_template_variables_to_collection, annotate_response, clone_collection, clone_criterion_set, clone_llm_config, clone_project, clone_prompt_template, create_collection, create_criterion_set, and create_experiment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to elluminate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to elluminate in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
elluminate requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
elluminate is developed by ellamind. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
